note: Scenario 005 (bead oo-rkm): loading upstream/oolite-tests/Checklist-files/Missions/CloakingDevice.oolite-save via the game's own -load argument calls [UNIVERSE populateNormalSpace] (PlayerEntityLoadSave.m:777), which fires the systemWillPopulate WORLD-SCRIPT EVENT (Universe.m:1732-1737). oolite-cloaking-device-mission.js:47-103 handles it and, in galaxy 5 with cloak unset, runs missionVariables.cloakcounter++ (:62), registers the ambush populator (:71) and spawns the cloaked Asp with its escorts (:77-80). THE FALSIFIABLE CORE: the fixture holds cloakcounter=6 ON DISK and the running engine reads 7 - a value the deserialiser merely copied would read 6. MEASURED CAUTION: asp-pirate is NOT mission-exclusive (shipdata.plist gives the ordinary Asp that role), so a system-wide count of it read 2, 3 and 4 across ten runs; the escorts are pinned through the LEADER's own escortGroup instead. provenance.scenario_knobs records the determinism knobs this golden was BLESSED with, and the acceptance gate asserts spec.json still agrees with them, so re-blessing with a new seed stays legal while silent drift between spec and golden is fatal.

stability.method: ten independent launches of tests/golden/mission_trigger.py, each into a fresh staged app copy on its own reserved port. The harness detects the dump ON DISK rather than inferring success from rc, so a run that wrote a correct dump but exited nonzero would be COUNTED and flagged, not hidden.
stability.note: A FIRST TEN-RUN PASS FAILED 2/10 and that failure is why this scenario's observable changed: the run aborted with countShipsWithRole('asp-pirate')==3 when 2 was expected, because asp-pirate is ALSO the ordinary Asp's role in shipdata.plist and the ambient populator writes to it (observed 2, 3 and 4). The escorts are now read off the ambush LEADER's own escortGroup, fixed by escorts=2 in the asp-cloaked template, and the second ten-run pass was 10/10 byte-identical. The flake was in the GATE's choice of observable, not in the engine.
